verdicts.reason: A actually rearranges the layout for the banner: the logo sits on the left, the can sits on the green circle on the right, and a large headline leads the hierarchy. However, the headline nearly touches both side edges, the bottom row (body copy and CTA) is pressed against the bottom edge, and the body copy sits half on the yellow circle. B is just a shrunken copy of the original. Its body line is tiny and hard to read, and it runs across the edge of the yellow circle. The CTA label is minuscule, the headline is too small to dominate, and the large yellow circle crowds the lower-left text block.
